name: collision
description: AABB + SAT collision detection, resolution, messaging; soft-couples to physics
postInstallNotes:
## collision installed

Attach `BoxColliderComponent` (AABB) or `ConvexColliderComponent` (SAT) plus the `ColliderTagComponent` marker to entities you want to collide. Both collider types feed the same detection system polymorphically.

Pipeline:
1. `TransformCollisionDetectionSystem` queries `ColliderTagComponent` entities, computes overlaps, publishes `CollisionMessage` per pair.
2. `TransformCollisionResolutionSystem` applies trigger-style responses (no impulse — message-only).
3. `TransformPhysicalCollisionResolutionSystem` applies impulse separation — **only useful when the `physics` block is also installed** (it reads `RigidBodyComponent` and `VelocityComponent`).

Subscribe to `CollisionMessage` in your game systems for trigger logic (pickups, doorways, dialogue zones).

**Premises:** `docs/premises.md`
